author.name: Requirements Reuben
author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: The Cost Cliff
challenge.description: The infrastructure bill for the monitoring stack has doubled, and #efficiency_emilia# has drawn a hard line: she will not fund automated drift monitoring, insisting it is a luxury the business cannot afford. #reliability_ruth# argues that without automated and governed drift checks, the team is flying blind during promotion weeks, and she refuses to accept a manual process as a substitute for reliable signal.

output.content: We can accept a manual alerting process to keep the infrastructure bill down, provided every notification is routed through the secure, logged channel we already use for data access requests. We are willing to give up the speed and automation of the current pipeline in exchange for a lower cost footprint. The manual step is the concession we are making to the budget. In return, we require that any manual intervention is fully traceable through that audited path. This trade allows us to maintain our privacy compliance posture while addressing the efficiency concerns. The manual handling is what we lose, and the secure routing is what we get to keep the system compliant.
output.reclassify_reason: The text explicitly states that the team is willing to give up the speed and automation of the current pipeline in exchange for a lower cost footprint.
